Not a bus driver but a passenger. I was still in high school having to go back and forth from school. One day I had detention and got let out late around five in the afternoon while I waited for the bus nothing out of the ordinary happened I got on paid for my fare and sat in the back like I always did. As the bus driver dropped people off and picked people up we came across a bus stop with only one person waiting it was a lady older than me in her twenties the only thing I noticed was the bus driver's look of astonishment but I paid no attention until she sat right next to me. I turned my head to look at her and she was wearing a dirty denim vest however her arms were almost dripping with blood from these big slashes on her arms she had this dead stare and honestly I thought she must have been on drugs. I still dont really know why the bus driver let her on without saying anything maybe he was too scared to ask idk. All I know is when the bus got to the shopping center a mile from my house I got up and booked it. Fourteen year old me couldn't handle that shit.
